occurrences.quote:
From passage [2]: Lee Jun-ho (singer), also known as Junho, is a member of 2PM, a South Korean boy band.

From passage [1]: Jay Park was the former leader of 2PM and officially left the group in early 2010.

So the group is 2PM, and both Jay Park and Lee Jun-ho are/were members. Jay Park left in early 2010.

**Critical gap:** The passages do NOT contain any information about a video called "Take Off" by 2PM, its release date, or when it was released relative to Jay Park's departure in early 2010.

[[ ## query ## ]]
When was the "Take Off" music video by 2PM released?

Lee Jun-ho (singer) | Lee Jun-ho (; born January 25, 1990), simply known as Junho, is a South Korean singer-songwriter, dancer and actor.  He is a member of the South Korean boy band 2PM.
2PM | 2PM (Hangul: 투피엠 ) is a South Korean boy band formed by JYP Entertainment.  The current members are Jun.  K (formerly known as Junsu), Nichkhun, Taecyeon, Wooyoung, Junho and Chansung.  Former leader Jay Park officially left the group in early 2010.
Take Off (2PM song) | "Take Off" is the debut Japanese single by South Korean boy band, 2PM.  This single was released on May 18, 2011 in 4 editions: CD+DVD, CD+Photobook, CD only limited and a Regular edition.
